target: methods/e02_friction_limit.py:69-78 (M2 / M3) and docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md section A (bracket claims 'M3 <= mu -> safe for sure', 'M2 > mu -> slips for sure', 'M2 = current h15 Q47')
claim: e02 treats the curved glued cage faces as flat. It keeps only the X-Y part of the tangential traction (a['f'].append(tau[:2] * A), line 71) and the X-Y face-centre coordinates (c[:2]). It drops the out-of-plane part of the tangential traction, which friction must also carry. On p062 this changes the answer several-fold. At t = 3.5 (follower load only, no moment yet, so the state is valid both before and after the load-curve fix), the in-plane shear that e02 uses is 1.47 N on the bottom face. The full tangential force is 11.02 N, and the existing h15 friction_demand of the corrected rerun gives exactly this value (bot_shear_N 11.0197, bot_normal_N 105.15). e02 M2 = 1.47 / 105.15 = 0.014; the h15 force ratio = 11.02 / 105.15 = 0.105, 7.5 times higher. Top face: 5.19 vs 7.58 N, M2 0.050 vs 0.072. Over whole windows of the corrected reruns (worst state, worst face), the in-plane M2 vs the full-tangential M2 are: p062 flexion 0.168 vs 0.191, extension 0.119 vs 0.169 (+42 %), LB 0.520 vs 0.524, AR 0.180 vs 0.185; p063 extension 0.117 vs 0.168; p014 extension 0.141 vs 0.203 (+44 %). The worst-case error is therefore 1-44 % at the window peaks and 7.5x at low load; it is largest in extension. So (1) the 'M2' column in METHODS_COMPARISON is not 'the current h15 Q47' force ratio it is labelled as. (2) M3 is not a proven upper bound ('safe for sure') on a curved face, because the out-of-plane tangential traction never enters the linear program. (3) 'M2 > mu -> slips for sure' is also unproven on a curved face: the normal pressure on inclined facets has an X-Y component (bottom face total Fx = -4.25 N vs tangential -1.47 N), and this geometric interlock can hold without friction. The bracket that is meant to pre-filter designs is therefore not a bracket for domed / concave-matched faces, which are exactly the faces evo will produce.

summary_zh: 摩擦需求計算程式（e02）把 cage 上下兩個彎曲的黏合面當成平面處理，只保留水平方向的剪力，丟掉沿曲面向上或向下的剪力。結果差很多：p062 設計在只加 100 牛頓壓力、還沒加彎曲力矩的時刻（這個時刻的資料在負荷曲線修正前後都有效），e02 算出下表面的剪力只有 1.47 牛頓，但完整的切向剪力是 11.02 牛頓，修正後重跑時另一套程式也得到 11.02 牛頓。也就是說，在低負荷時 e02 的「力比值」低估了大約 7.5 倍；在各方向力矩最大的時刻，低估幅度是 1% 到 44%，後伸時最大。因此，方法比較文件中「M2 就是目前使用的力比值」這個說法不正確；「M3 小於摩擦係數就一定安全」和「M2 大於摩擦係數就一定滑動」這兩句話，對彎曲的接觸面也都沒有被證明。演化設計產生的正是貼合終板曲面的彎曲接觸面，所以這個問題會直接影響篩選結果。
